#Annalie.Face.shocked
Bot: I remember that he set up the camera and-
You: How about we change topics, huh?
Lady Annalie: Change topics?! It’s not a laughing matter!
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: And she was about to go to the best part!
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: No, no, no, it’s not like that! {f_botName} is just playing around.
Lady Annalie: Oh, you got me! She was telling it all with a straight face so I was late to catch the joke. You are pretty funny {f_botName}!
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: Thanks I guess.
